name: missive
description: Connect to Missive through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Missive hosts an official MCP server on current Productive or Business plans, and an admin must enable MCP for every organization the person belongs to. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256, public clients (token auth none). Missive is a client over the person's email and calendar accounts (such as Gmail and Outlook), so conversations and calendars reach Kipster through Missive's cloud; kept because it is the person's own Missive account rather than an aggregator, and flagged as a third-party data flow.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
